newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close up after late recovery.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close up after late recovery.

text.p: Thai stocks staged a surprise recovery late on Tuesday from earlier losses which saw the market fall as much as 1.55 percent.

The SET Index ended up 1.48 points, or 0.26 percent, at 569.84. The SET 50 closed up 0.14 points or 0.34 percent at 41.28. Market closure in New York and London on Monday reduced turnover to a thin 2.46 billion baht.
Traders said some local mutual and foreign funds may have been active buyers. They saw no evidence of a bank-backed support fund entering the market as it had done on Monday.

"I'm absolutely amazed at the support for the market today. When it opened I thought it was going down the pan. There seems to have been no positive news to account for the turnaround, but I haven't seen any evidence of the support fund today," said a senior trader at one local house.
Brokers said local mutual funds may have swayed the market, though at least one local fund manager said the market remained unattractive.
"There is a list of negative factors as long as your arm...there is deinitely some value. But it depends on your time horizon, and for us the time is not yet right," he said.
